import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(".ufo/evidence/round-14")
a=json.loads((p/"dispositions-before.json").read_text())
b=json.loads((p/"dispositions.json").read_text())
ar=a.pop("rows");br=b.pop("rows")
assert a==b
changed=[x["name"] for x,y in zip(ar,br,strict=True) if x!=y]
assert changed==["producer_before"]
old=next(x for x in ar if x["name"]=="producer_before")
new=next(x for x in br if x["name"]=="producer_before")
assert old["receipt"]==new["raw_receipt"] and old["check"]==new["raw_check"]
print(json.dumps({"top_level_pins_unchanged":True,"changed_rows":changed,"original_observation_binding_preserved":True,"expected_rows":len(br)},sort_keys=True))
